regions.merged_text: I hope you are well and that by this time things have brightened in regard to your little Mary. I put your letter aside - having noted your favor, for which many thanks, a special Mass at the time - and then lost track of it, I wanted to answer it personally. I surely sympathize with you and your family. We have had quite a few cases similar to little Mary's, the majority of which, thanks be to God, have come through astonishingly well. They sometimes seem miraculous. Glory be to God.
